THE PROJECT

Doodle Dept.

Introduction

Doodle Dept is BTG’s merchandise line for overworked, over inspired and creatively employed people. We designed a story led Shopify website that felt less like a conventional online store and more like entering the department itself. Witty copy, hand drawn doodles, bold yellow accents and unexpected details brought the brand’s self aware personality into every page, while a clear shopping journey made the experience easy to explore and purchase from.
